  • Proven ability to manage multiple onboarding timelines at once without losing quality.
  • Strong written and verbal communication that builds trust and momentum.
  • Comfort working in CRM systems to track progress, risks, and outcomes.
  • Ability to adapt onboarding approaches to different business models and client needs.
  • Ownership mindset with accountability for outcomes, not just meetings completed.
  • Comfort working asynchronously with cross-functional partners.

Must Have Background

  • Two or more years of experience in SaaS onboarding, implementation, or client-facing roles.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage customers through multi-step, multi-week setup processes with consistent follow-through.

Nice-To-Have Background

  • Experience with PushPress software (current/former client)
  • Background in SMB ownership and management, especially gyms and fitness operations.
  • Understanding how fitness businesses operate and having the skills to educate, understand and question practices based on the software’s capabilities
  • Experience supporting CRM pipelines, lead management, or messaging workflows.
  • Two or more years of experience in gym ownership, gym management, or fitness operations.

Tools and Systems

What We're Looking For

jobs.description:
Why this Role Matters

At Greenbox Capital, we help small businesses thrive by giving them fast, accessible funding. As an Expediter, you’ll play a critical role in protecting portfolio quality while supporting revenue growth through sound, timely underwriting decisions.

You bring strong financial analysis skills, close attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to collaborate across teams to keep deals moving efficiently. You’re naturally curious and open to using AI tools to improve research, analysis, workflow efficiency, and problem-solving, while still applying independent judgment, maintaining accuracy, and following company policies.

In this role, you’ll identify, gather, and analyze the information needed to assess credit risk and determine sources of repayment. You’ll make thoughtful underwriting decisions, including declining applications when necessary, while ensuring decisions align with Greenbox Capital’s credit policies and risk philosophy. Your work will help us move quickly without compromising the quality and sound judgment behind each decision.

How You’ll Be Measured

Credit Analysis & Risk Assessment – 50%

  • Conduct detailed financial analysis of merchant applications, including bank statements, financial statements, tax returns, and supporting business documentation.
  • Evaluate merchant credibility and repayment ability using cash flow analysis, ratio analysis, trend review, and verification of submitted information.
  • Identify risk factors within each deal, detect red flags, and resolve inconsistencies using internal tools and documentation.
  • Research business reputation through public reporting sources to assess reputational and operational risk.
  • Make approval or decline recommendations in alignment with company risk tolerance and policies.

Application Processing & Compliance – 20%

  • Ensure underwriting decisions comply with internal credit policies, procedures, and Greenbox Capital’s risk philosophy.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and complete files to support audit and compliance standards.
  • Meet established service-level agreements (SLAs) and turn-time commitments to support business velocity.

Quality Assurance & Final Review – 15%

  • Conduct final underwriting reviews of files completed by peers prior to decisioning.
  • Verify compliance with underwriting guidelines, documentation standards, and approval authority requirements.
  • Ensure consistency of risk assessment and decision quality across the underwriting team.
  • Escalate material concerns, inconsistencies, or high-risk findings to leadership when appropriate.

Cross-Functional Communication & Deal Support – 15%

  • Communicate clearly and professionally with ISOs, Brokers Support, and merchants via written and verbal channels.
  • Partner with Sales, Broker Support, and Risk teams to clarify documentation, verify information, and move deals efficiently through the pipeline.
  • Escalate complex or high-risk cases appropriately to leadership.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Approval quality and portfolio performance (loss rate alignment)
  • SLA adherence / Speed to decision
  • Documentation accuracy and compliance standards
  • Deal throughput volume
  • Escalation accuracy and risk flag detection

You’re a Strong Fit if You:

  • High attention to detail and strong pattern recognition skills.
  • Sound judgment and ability to make data-driven decisions independently.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Customer-service oriented with professional interpersonal skills.
  • Demonstrates integrity, accountability, and alignment with Greenbox Capital’s commitment to service and teamwork.
  • Curious mindset with a desire to understand the “why” behind financial trends and business performance.
  • AI-curious and solutions-oriented, with a willingness to ask questions, test new ideas, and explore practical ways to improve existing processes.

What You’ve Done Before:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or related field required.
  • 1–3+ years of experience in underwriting, financial analysis, credit risk, or related financial services field preferred.
  • Proven ability to analyze financial statements and assess repayment risk.
  • Experience reviewing bank statements and business financial documentation required.

Tools and Expertise You’ll Bring:

  • Strong understanding of cash flow analysis, credit risk assessment, and underwriting fundamentals.
  • Ability to detect patterns, inconsistencies, and potential manipulation in financial documentation.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial analysis tools.
  • Strong analytical thinking and sound decision-making skills with minimal supervision.
  • Understanding seasonality, industry trends, and small business financial behavior preferred.
  • Comfortable exploring and leveraging AI tools to improve efficiency, research, documentation, and problem-solving within the underwriting process.
  • Demonstrates curiosity and initiative in identifying opportunities where AI or automation may support faster, more accurate, or more consistent workflows.
  • Ability to use AI-supported insights responsibly while applying independent judgment, validating information, and following company policies and risk standards.

What to Expect from Our Interview Process

We believe in a respectful, efficient, and transparent hiring experience. Here’s what you can expect:

Step 1: Interview with People & Culture (30 minutes)

Step 2: Hiring Manager Interview (1 hour)

Step 3: Role-Specific Assessment or Panel Interview (1 hour)

Step 4: Final Interview or Leadership Chat (1 hour)

Step 5: Offer & Background Check

If it’s a mutual fit, we’ll move forward with background check and present a competitive offer.

💸 Competitive Pay - We know your worth and we pay accordingly.

🌴 Flexible PTO - Work hard, rest well. Take the time you need to recharge.

🏡 Remote - Fully remote within the U.S., working Eastern Time hours to keep everyone aligned.

🩺 Full Benefits Package - Health, dental, vision

🧠 Smart, Supportive Teammates - Collaborate with sharp minds who are kind, driven and uphold our core values

Dynata is seeking a AI Learning & Enablement Lead to design and deliver practical learning programs, enablement resources, and adoption support that help employees and leaders use approved AI tools more effectively. This role will focus on building usable learning experiences, prompt resources, quality checklists, workshops, office hours, and role-based enablement materials for tools such as Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Perplexity, and other approved platforms.

This is a learning, enablement, and adoption role. It is not a technical AI engineering role. The role will partner with HR, Technology, Legal, Information Security, Communications, and business stakeholders to ensure learning content reflects approved AI practices and helps teams improve the quality of AI-assisted work.

The successful candidate will bring strong learning design, facilitation, change support, and hands-on AI tool experience, with the ability to translate AI concepts into practical resources employees can use in the flow of work.

Key Responsibilities

AI Learning & Enablement Program Execution

  • Support implementation of Dynata's AI enablement priorities through learning programs, workshops, campaigns, and practical resources.

  • Design and deliver AI curricula, office hours, microlearning, manager sessions, learning campaigns, and community-of-practice content.

  • Build role-based learning pathways for priority employee groups in partnership with Talent, HR, and business stakeholders.

  • Translate AI concepts into clear, practical learning materials that employees can apply to real work.

  • Coordinate learning calendars, program launches, stakeholder inputs, and adoption support activities.

AI Tool Enablement & Practical Application

  • Develop enablement content for Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Perplexity, and other approved enterprise AI tools.

  • Create prompt examples, use-case guides, facilitation materials, quick-reference tools, and job aids.

  • Help employees understand when and how to use AI tools appropriately, including where human review is required.

  • Support teams in applying AI to common work activities such as drafting, summarizing, analysis support, meeting preparation, communications, and learning design.

  • Gather feedback from learners and stakeholders to improve AI enablement content over time.

AI Quality & Output Support

  • Create practical checklists and guidance to help employees review AI outputs for accuracy, completeness, usefulness, tone, evidence, and next steps.

  • Teach prompt writing, output review, source validation habits, and responsible use behaviors through learning experiences and job aids.

  • Build reusable playbooks that help teams reduce low-quality AI outputs and improve consistency.

  • Partner with subject matter experts to validate examples and align materials with approved practices.

  • Reinforce that AI-assisted work requires employee judgment, review, and accountability.

Upskilling and Role-Based Learning Support

  • Partner with HR and business stakeholders to identify AI-related learning needs for priority roles and functions.

  • Develop learning solutions that support employees as work expectations evolve due to AI and automation.

  • Contribute to upskilling resources that help employees build confidence using AI tools responsibly and effectively.

  • Support AI champions, learning ambassadors, and function-specific adoption efforts.

  • Escalate questions related to AI risk, governance, privacy, or prohibited use to the appropriate subject matter owners.

Learning Measurement & Continuous Improvement

  • Track learning participation, learner feedback, completion, proficiency self-assessments, and practical adoption indicators.

  • Summarize program results and learner insights for Talent and business stakeholders.

  • Use feedback and adoption patterns to refine learning content, job aids, and enablement programs.

  • Contribute to, but do not own, broader enterprise AI capability maturity dashboards or business impact reporting.

  • Demonstrated ability to support enterprise technology adoption or digital capability-building initiatives.

  • Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders and translating business needs into practical learning solutions.

  • Strong facilitation, instructional design, communications, and program coordination skills.

AI Experience

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Perplexity, and similar platforms.

  • Strong working knowledge of prompt writing, AI output review, responsible AI practices, and human-in-the-loop review.

  • Ability to teach employees how to use AI tools effectively for common business tasks.

The Constructive Dialogue Institute (CDI) is a non-partisan, non-profit dedicated to equipping the next generation of Americans with the skills to communicate and collaborate across lines of difference. We work with U.S. colleges and universities by providing co-curricular programming for students, professional development for faculty and staff, and strategic guidance to leadership. Our goal is to foster constructive dialogue at every level of the institution and to create the conditions for lasting organizational change. CDI was co-founded by psychologist Jonathan Haidt, the bestselling author of The Righteous Mind and The Anxious Generation.

About the Role

CDI seeks an experienced, highly organized Senior Program Manager to serve as the operational backbone of the Leadership Institute (LI), CDI's program to equip senior higher education leaders with the strategy, tools, and peer network to advance cultures of inquiry and dialogue on their campuses. This full-time, remote role works closely with the Vice President of Leadership Programs to run LI's full-year arc: the fall Summit, monthly institutional coaching, quarterly Peer Learning Communities, and each cohort's measurement and reporting cycle.

In your first 90 days, you'll learn LI end-to-end by shadowing coaching calls and supporting Summit planning, getting fluent in our systems and templates, and planning for the year-long engagement. By month three, you'll independently manage scheduling and logistics for our Leadership Institute partners.

By month six, you'll manage the operating rhythm for the full cohort year, tracking institution progress, flagging risks to the VP, running day-to-day partner communication, and recommending process improvements.

Within your first year, you'll be a trusted first point of contact for campus teams on coordination and progress, and a trusted operational partner with the VP.

The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of program operations and relationship management: strong execution, an instinct for spotting opportunities and process improvements, and good judgment about what to flag versus solve directly. The Senior Program Manager reports to the Vice President of Leadership Programs.

Responsibilities

Program & Portfolio Management

  • Keep the Vice President and broader team ahead of deadlines across all concurrent workstreams, within and across cohort years.

  • Track each institution's strategic priorities throughout the year and escalate stalled progress or risks.

  • Identify and design improvements to LI's operating systems and templates (discovery process, communications cadence, reporting formats) in partnership with the VP.

Institution & Partner Liaison

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for institutional teams on scheduling, onboarding, pre-work, and follow-up across the full year.

Cross-Team Coordination & Communication

  • Manage meeting cadence and information flow among the VP, consulting, partnerships, and impact teams

jobs.description:
Concord Servicingsits at the center of the credit market ecosystem. We provide loan servicing, backup servicing, and capital markets administration for specialty finance lenders, institutional investors, and asset managers. Our clients include originators across fintech, solar, home improvement, equipment finance, and other specialty asset classes. When a lender needs a trusted partner to service their portfolio or a trustee needs real-time reporting, they call Concord Servicing.

Our Mission

We exist to deliver exceptional servicing outcomes for our clients and borrowers by combining deep domain expertise, proprietary technology, and a steadfast focus on compliance, risk management, and client service. We aim to be the go-to partner across the credit lifecycle for both consumer-finance and commercial/lease portfolios.

About the Role

GTM Operations at Concord Servicing is the infrastructure and strategy layer behind our go-to-market organization. We are actively building that engine: client health scoring across three business units, an ICP-fit scoring model with Clay, our first AI agent for prospect research, deal-level pipeline attribution, and an in-house outbound program. There is a great deal still to build.

Reporting directly to the CMO, the VP, Head of GTM Operations will own that engine end to end and set its direction. You will partner daily with marketing on top-of-funnel campaigns and account-based plays, with the CRO and the sales organization on the outbound motion, and with the Managing Directors who lead our Consumer, Commercial, and Capital Markets business units for embedded base upsell strategies and reporting. You will lead a lean team, including a Revenue Operations Lead (a hands-on GTM architect) and the analysts in our Mexico City operations center. You will also produce the pipeline and funnel reporting that goes to our private equity sponsor monthly and to our board quarterly, and your numbers will hold up under partner-level scrutiny.

This is an owner-operator role. You open the tools and build. You will be hands-on in Clay tables, HubSpot workflows, enrichment logic, scoring models, and agent configuration, shipping the work in tandem with others and then teach your team to run it. You can defend a number in a board meeting and change a workflow the same afternoon.

The right person brings structure to undefined problems, moves with urgency, holds a clear point of view about how a modern go-to-market engine should run, and raises the standard of everyone who works around them.

This role is remote within the United States.

What You’ll Do

This is a leadership role with full ownership of the revenue engine, a small team to build it with, and direct exposure to the executive team and our sponsor.

GTM Systems & Data

  • Own the go-to-market stack end-to-end, including HubSpot, Clay, Apollo, Sendoso, Gong, and the tooling around them, with final say on architecture, build-versus-buy, and vendor selection.
  • Set the standard for data hygiene, lifecycle definitions, and lead and signal routing across all three business units, including the fields a deal must carry to be trusted.
  • Build personally where it matters most, then hand the pattern to your team to maintain and scale.

Scoring, Signals & AI

  • Own the scoring layer: the ICP-fit model in Clay, client health scoring across Consumer, Commercial, and Capital Markets, and the engagement scoring now in build.
  • Extend agentic workflows beyond Rex, our first GTM AI agent, into research, enrichment, routing, and reporting, measured in hours saved and cleaner data.
  • Keep the signal infrastructure current: the buyer personas and the account universe the outbound motion runs on.

Demand Generation & ABM

  • Partner with marketing on top-of-funnel campaigns and the outbound sales motion: the target accounts, the segments and asset classes we go after, and the systems underneath.
  • Own the ABM strategy with marketing: account selection, tiering, scoring, and the plays we run against priority accounts.
  • Own data enrichment and prospect research for the go-to-market team: account and contact data, list builds, and the research that feeds every campaign and sequence.

Measurement & Board Reporting

  • Own marketing-sourced revenue reporting on a definition the board trusts. This is a number of record.
  • Own deal-level pipeline attribution and the reporting behind it, so the answer to where pipeline originates holds up when leadership pushes on it.
  • Produce the pipeline and funnel analytics for monthly sponsor reviews and quarterly board decks, plus the weekly metrics the executive team runs on: coverage, conversion, meetings, and SQLs.
  • Own the systems and governance behind the win-loss program, and drive forecast accuracy up quarter over quarter.

Process & Rules of Engagement

  • Set how the revenue motion runs, from how an account gets owned to how a lead is qualified to how a deal moves stage to stage, and hold the go-to-market team to that standard.
  • Define the rules of engagement, qualification criteria, and handoff SLAs across marketing, business development, sales, and implementation, with your team maintaining them day to day.
  • Partner with sales leadership on the outbound engine: they own the team and the coaching, you own the model it runs on, including targeting, the qualification bar, cadence standards, and how performance is measured.
  • Lead change management when the model changes, from the executive team through to the people who work in it every day.

Planning & Executive Partnership

  • Bring the operational inputs to annual and quarterly planning: coverage ratios, funnel math, capacity, and territory and comp assumptions, in partnership with Finance.
  • Serve as the operations partner to the CEO, CFO, and the business-unit Managing Directors. When a number moves, you know why before the meeting starts.
  • Help revenue and marketing leadership decide which plays we run next, and what we set down to make room for them.

Team Leadership

  • Lead the Revenue Operations Lead and the analysts in our Mexico City operations center with clear direction and tight feedback loops rather than layers of process.
  • Review the team’s work, teach the craft, and raise the standard of what ships.
  • Hire and develop as the function scales, and build a bench that can own what you build.

The engine you build here will set how this go-to-market organization operates as it scales.

Requirements

Who You Are

  • 7+ years in revenue, go-to-market, or sales operations, with demonstrated progression in scope and ownership. Trajectory and shipped work matter more to us than years.
  • Hands-On Builder: You can open Clay, HubSpot, and an enrichment tool and build the scoring model, workflow, or routing logic yourself. You have done it recently and can show it.
  • Shipped AI Record: You have put AI to work in a go-to-market motion: agents, enrichment, or automation you configured and moved into production.
  • Quantitative Depth: Pipeline math, coverage ratios, funnel conversion, attribution logic, and the modeling behind capacity and comp. You interrogate a report you did not build rather than take it at face value.
  • Executive Presence: Credible with a CEO, a CFO, Managing Directors, a private equity sponsor, and boards, and able to defend a number under scrutiny.
  • Decisive Team Leader: You give clear direction to a lean onshore team and junior nearshore analysts, delegate with tight feedback loops, and make the work around you better.
  • Industry Fit: Experience in B2B fintech, financial services, or a services-and-software business is a plus.

About the role

We’re looking for a Head of Creative Production to build, lead and scale the team responsible for turning creative strategy into high-performing ad creative at volume. This is a leadership role, not a production role.

You won’t be making the ads yourself. You’ll be owning the team, systems and standards that allow a creative production function to do its best work: consistently, efficiently and at the pace our clients need.

You’ll lead a team of Visual Creators (VCs) across multiple time zones and work closely with Creative Strategists and Growth Strategists to turn strategy into execution.

This role sits at the intersection of people leadership, creative quality, operational systems and commercial outcomes.

If you enjoy building teams, improving systems, raising standards and figuring out how to make things work better as they scale, we'd love to hear from you.

What you’ll own

1. Creative Quality: You own the executional standard of the work your team produces. You know the difference between something being technically finished and something being genuinely good. You set a clear creative bar, make sure the team understands it, and coach people towards it.

2. Production Velocity: You operate a production engine that moves. You own the systems, priorities and rhythms that allow the team to consistently deliver the volume our clients need without sacrificing quality. You spot bottlenecks, understand what’s slowing the team down and work out how to remove them.

3. Production Systems & Scalability: You build the infrastructure that allows the production function to grow. That includes team structure, workflows, capacity planning, resource allocation, processes and the way Production connects into the wider Creative and Growth functions. You’re constantly asking “How do we make this work better at 2x the volume?”

4. Team Performance & Development: You build a team that knows what good looks like and has the capability to consistently deliver it. You understand the strengths, gaps and development needs of your VCs. You coach through real work, give clear feedback, recognise performance patterns and create the conditions for people to do their best work. Success isn’t one or two standout VCs, it’s consistent performance across the whole team.

5. Creative Strategy and Production: You own the connection between Creative Strategy and Production. Creative Strategists communicate the why behind the ads, and your team should be able to translate that into strong execution without unnecessary friction. You make sure the handover between strategy and production is clear, efficient and continuously improving.

6. Cross-functional Leadership: Creative Production doesn’t operate in a silo. You’ll work closely with Creative Strategy, Growth Strategy and Media Buying to understand what the clients’ accounts need, how creative is performing and what the production function needs to do to deliver. You bring the production perspective into those conversations and make sure the team is aligned with the bigger commercial picture.

What we’re looking for

  • You have a high creative bar: You can look at an ad and immediately spot when something isn't working. You understand creative quality, but you also understand that good-looking creative isn’t automatically high-performing creative. You can articulate what needs to improve and coach someone towards a better outcome.
  • You think in systems: You naturally spot patterns, bottlenecks and unnecessary friction. When something isn’t working, your instinct is to understand why and improve the system, not just solve the same problem again next week.
  • You use data to make decisions: You understand capacity, utilisation, prioritisation, output, revision rates, quality and delivery. You don’t need every answer to be in a spreadsheet, but you use data to understand what is actually happening inside your function and make better decisions as a result.
  • You’re comfortable with pace and ambiguity: Right Hook moves quickly. Priorities change. Clients change. Platforms change. The market changes. You stay calm, reprioritise and keep the team moving. And if you’re unsure, you raise your hand early rather than sitting on a problem.
  • You have experience leading creative teams: You have a track record of managing and developing creative production, creative operations or creative teams, ideally within a digital agency or performance marketing environment. You understand paid social creative, how creative gets produced at volume, and how to QA work against both strategic and executional standards.

What we offer

  • USD $30,000 - USD $36,000 per annum (depending on experience)
  • Fully remote: SEA or LATAM based
  • Direct line to senior leadership with genuine input into how the function evolves
  • Real ownership: you’ll have the opportunity to scale a function that directly impacts client growth and company performance

Minimum Requirements

  • 3+ years leading a creative production or creative operations function within a digital agency or performance marketing environment.
  • Demonstrated experience developing people and owning team output.
  • Demonstrated understanding of paid social creative and digital advertising.
  • Demonstrated organisational and operational skills.
  • Comfortable with flexible schedule to work across AU & US time zones. Primary working hours align with the Australian time zone, occasional overlap required with the US time zone.
  • Reliable, high-speed WiFi connection.
  • Your own laptop and functional workspace setup.

Think you're the right fit? Here's how to apply:

1. Upload your resume (no cover letter needed)

2. Answer the following questions when prompted:

  • How many years of experience do you have leading a creative production team?
  • How many people have you directly managed at one time?
  • Share a link to an ad that you think is exceptional and tell us why it works.

3. Bonus: We'd love to see examples of creative work produced under your leadership that you consider representative of the standard you hold your team to.

Hi, I'm Kelsey, the VP of Customer Success at EnsoData! We're excited to announce that we're looking for a new teammate - a Clinical Solutions Specialist passionate about making healthcare better!

The Clinical Solutions Specialist serves as a clinical subject matter expert and customer-facing partner, supporting both pre- and post-sale activities. This role is responsible for delivering high-quality product demonstrations, clinical training, and ongoing solution support to healthcare customers, while closely collaborating with Sales Account Executives to support pipeline development and deal success.

Clinical Demonstrations & Sales Support

  • Deliver compelling, clinically accurate product demonstrations to prospective customers in partnership with Sales Account Executives.
  • Support the sales cycle by addressing clinical workflows, use cases, and outcomes-related questions from clinicians and administrators.

Customer Training & Enablement

  • Conduct clinical onboarding and training sessions (virtual and in-person) for new customers, tailored to specific clinical roles and workflows.
  • Develop and refine clinical training materials, best practices, and enablement resources in collaboration with Product, Customer Success, and Marketing.

Customer Success & Adoption Support

  • Provide ongoing clinical guidance, workflow optimization recommendations, and product usage insights post-implementation.
  • Participate in customer check-ins, QBRs, and feedback loops to capture clinical insights and inform product improvements.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as the voice of the clinician internally, providing feedback to Product and Engineering teams on usability, workflow alignment, and feature needs.
  • Support internal enablement by training Sales, Customer Success, and other teams on clinical use cases and product updates.

Compliance & Professional Standards

  • Ensure all customer-facing activities align with regulatory, compliance, and quality requirements applicable to medical devices and SaMD products.
  • Maintain current knowledge of clinical best practices, industry standards, and relevant healthcare regulations.

About EnsoData

EnsoData strives to make healthcare more accurate, efficient, and affordable through waveform artificial intelligence (AI) technology. Using AI and machine learning, our software analyzes billions of data points collected from sensors placed throughout the human body. Our first solution, EnsoSleep, reduces the time clinicians spend analyzing, scoring and managing sleep studies. This results in a simplified and accelerated patient testing, diagnosis, and treatment workflow. Our AI-powered technology has the capability of informing health decisions beyond sleep medicine, from monitoring patient health in the ICU or through wearables, to detecting and capturing seizure data, to providing earlier detection of heart disease, diabetes, stroke, and Alzheimer’s.

Here is a little about what we are doing in the world of sleep medicine...

EnsoHST- FDA-Cleared, AI-Powered Sleep Diagnosis Using Pulse Oximeters

EnsoSleep - FDA-Cleared PSG and HSAT Scoring and Study Management

**Here is a link to learn a little about our Celeste app!

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in a clinical, scientific, or healthcare-related field preferred, or equivalent work experience
  • 3+ years of relevant clinical, clinical support, clinical applications, or healthcare technology experience.
  • RPSGT Certification (required)
  • Hands-on experience working with clinicians in a hospital, health system, or clinical practice environment.
  • Experience delivering clinical training, product demonstrations, or workflow education to healthcare audiences.
  • Experience supporting sales teams or working in a pre-sales, post-sales, or customer success capacity preferred.

Preferred

  • Located in MST or PST time zones
  • Certified in Clinical Sleep Health (CCSH)
  • Certified Respiratory Therapist - Sleep Disorders Specialty
  • Registered Respiratory Therapist - Sleep Disorders Specialty

Company Culture - Embrace the Pineapple! How do we do this?

Make Healthcare Better - is passionate about moving healthcare to a better place for everyone everywhere

Put Customers First - delights customers by working closely with them to support their initiatives

Be a Great Teammate - spreads the good vibes and is a joy to work with; also understands the value of helping one's teammates

Gets $#!t Done - bias toward action and intrinsically motivated to go above and beyond; demonstrates the ability to work autonomously as well as across teams

We also practice a Focus on Quality and look for teammates who don't cut corners and demonstrate integrity and attention to detail

Benefits

The benefits package includes, but is not limited to, the following:

Hybrid/Remote Company - we are a company with hybrid and remote options. That being said, we have an amazing office headquarters in downtown Madison, WI with views of the capitol that you are welcome to work from at anytime. In case you didn't know, Madison has consistently been ranked as one of the top places to live in the US (businessinsider.com, money.com, livability.com)!

Health, dental, and vision insurance with options to choose a plan that fits you and your dependents needs.

Paid time off options - we want our employees to rest, recharge, and feel better.

Stock options - we want team members to feel ownership in the organization. When EnsoData does well, you do well.

Company Bonus Program - if we do well, we want to reward our team members! This position may include participation in the company bonus program.

Team Summits! We look forward to opportunities to gather in person and enjoy a few days together. We participate in team events and gain some great in-person time. (Hint: check out our blog for info from former team gatherings!)

Why LeoLabs?

At LeoLabs, we’re building the living map of activity in space. Through our proprietary global radar network and AI-enabled analytics platform, we collect millions of measurements daily on more than 25,000 objects in low Earth orbit (LEO). Our radar-powered intelligence protects billions in assets, monitors adversarial behavior, and ensures safe operations for commercial and government missions.

We’re not just building technology, we are redefining global security, safety, and transparency in space. As orbital activity accelerates and threats grow more complex, LeoLabs is a trusted partner for Space Domain Awareness, Space Traffic Management, and Satellite Operations for top-tier space operators and allied defense organizations.

If you're looking to work on mission-critical challenges at the forefront of aerospace, national security, and AI, your impact starts here.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking an Administrative Operations Apprentice through the SkillBridge program. This is a 6-month apprenticeship designed specifically for current U.S. military service members who are eligible to participate in the SkillBridge program and are preparing to transition from military to civilian careers.

The apprentice will report directly to the Director of Recruiting and Talent Strategy and provide hands-on administrative and operational support across candidate coordination, scheduling, systems, reporting, and recruiting operations.

This is an opportunity to translate military experience into practical corporate skills while gaining exposure to a fast-paced, global technology organization.

What You’ll Do

  • Coordinate and manage candidate interviews across multiple time zones
  • Partner with administrative staff to support candidate travel and onsite interview logistics
  • Serve as a point of contact for candidates regarding interview scheduling and logistics
  • Maintain accurate candidate and requisition information within Greenhouse, our applicant tracking system
  • Generate recruiting reports and metrics directly from Greenhouse
  • Assist with data audits and identify or resolve missing or inaccurate information
  • Track follow-up items, deadlines, and action items to support team execution
  • Support recruiting-related scheduling and coordination
  • Assist with special projects and process improvement initiatives
  • Provide administrative and operational support to the Director of Recruiting and Talent Strategy and team

What You’ll Gain

  • Hands-on experience in corporate administration and operations
  • Practical experience with business systems, including Greenhouse
  • Experience managing complex scheduling and coordination across multiple time zones
  • Exposure to recruiting operations and candidate experience
  • Experience working with business data, reporting, and operational metrics
  • Development of professional communication, organization, and problem-solving skills
  • Experience working directly with experienced business leaders in a global technology organization
  • Transferable skills applicable to future careers in business operations, administration, project coordination, recruiting, or related corporate functions

Who You Are

  • Current U.S. military service member eligible to participate in the DoD SkillBridge program
  • Able to participate in the full 6-month apprenticeship prior to military separation
  • Background in administration, personnel, operations, logistics, program coordination, or a related area
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and follow-through
  • Comfortable managing multiple priorities, deadlines, and moving pieces
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Comfortable learning new technology and systems
  • Proactive, resourceful, and able to work independently
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to take ownership
  • Comfortable handling confidential information appropriately
  • Interested in developing a career in business operations, administration, project coordination, or a related corporate function

This Opportunity

The SkillBridge program provides transitioning service members with an opportunity to gain valuable civilian work experience before leaving military service. At LeoLabs, you’ll have the opportunity to apply your existing military skills while developing new capabilities in a professional corporate environment.

This apprenticeship is an opportunity to build practical, transferable skills while contributing to a mission-driven organization at the forefront of aerospace, national security, and AI.

jobs.title: Market Research to UX Research Career Changer
jobs.excerpt: About the Program:Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online.
jobs.description:
About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.
You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

jobs.description:
Client Strategy Manager, Activation

About InMarket

Since 2010, InMarket has been the leader in 360-degree consumer intelligence and real-time activation for thousands of today's top brands. Through InMarket's data-driven marketing platform, brands can build targeted audiences, activate media in real time, and measure success in driving return on ad spend. InMarket's proprietary Moments offering outperforms traditional mobile advertising by 6x.* Our LCI attribution platform, which won the MarTech Breakthrough Award for Best Advertising Measurement Platform, was validated by Forrester to drive an average of $40 ROAS for our clients.

*Source: Wordstream US Google Display Benchmarks for Mobile Media

About the Role

InMarket is seeking a strategic, commercially-minded Client Strategy Manager to join our Activation Client Strategy team.

You will partner with Sales Directors, Account Management, Ad Operations, and Data Analysts across the full client lifecycle to shape RFP responses and strategic proposals pre-sale, then use in-flight and post-campaign performance to inform smarter planning, deepen relationships, and grow the account.

We are also looking for someone fluent in AI who can build reusable skills, agents, and workflows that drive efficiencies and amplify outputs.

Core Areas of Responsibility

Media Planning & Strategic Recommendations

  • Own the development of InMarket media plans and strategic recommendations that connect a client's business objectives to specific audiences, Moments, channels, budgets, and flighting

  • Build client-facing planning collateral: proposals, one-pagers, category POVs, and strategy decks that are accurate but creative, succinct but thorough.

  • Keep abreast of emerging consumer behaviors, media channels, technologies, and competitors impacting our clients' categories, and feed that back into how we plan

Pre-Sales Partnership & Commercial Growth

  • Lead the strategic response to RFPs and briefs, partnering with Sales to shape a differentiated, winnable point of view

  • Co-present at client meetings and on calls, representing the strategic rationale behind the plan with confidence and clarity

  • Use in-flight and prior campaign performance to inform the next plan, turning results into the reason for the client's next investment

  • Act as an internal resource for Sales, Marketing, and Product on how best to position InMarket's activation capabilities against a given client challenge

Storytelling & Client Insight

  • Translate complex data into a simple, compelling narrative to state the non-obvious learning and answer the 'So What?' and 'Now What?'

  • Partner with Account Management, Ad Operations, and Data Insights Analysts to interpret campaign performance and convert it into forward-looking planning guidance

  • Present recommendations and results to internal and external audiences, ensuring the message lands clearly with both marketers and their agencies

  • Contribute to Quarterly Business Reviews, identifying macro trends and growth opportunities spanning multiple campaigns on key accounts

AI Fluency & Ways of Working

  • Use AI tools as a core part of the daily workflow for category research, data synthesis, competitive scanning, plan drafting, and building client-facing materials

  • Go beyond basic prompting to build reusable AI skills, templates, and agentic workflows that encode our planning best practices and scale across the team

  • Bring a kaizen mindset of small, continuous improvements to process, templates, and output quality that is driven proactively

Impact & Success Indicators

In your first 90 days

  • Fluent in InMarket's activation products, audience taxonomy, Moments capabilities, and how they map to common client objectives

  • Independently leading the strategic response on RFPs and briefs for assigned accounts

  • Trusted by your Sales partners to co-present the plan and defend the rationale on client calls

  • Built or improved at least one AI-assisted workflow that measurably speeds up a recurring part of the planning process

  • Delivered a strategic recommendation that surfaced an opportunity the client had not asked about

In your first year

  • Recognized as a go-to strategic partner for your accounts

  • A demonstrable track record of contributing to won business and organic account growth through upsell and expansion recommendations

  • Your planning narratives and frameworks are reused across the wider team as the standard

  • Shipped reusable AI skills or workflows that are adopted beyond your own accounts and have shortened proposal turnaround times

  • Consistently spotting category and behavioral trends early, and translating them into commercial opportunities for InMarket and our clients

We're Looking for Someone With

  • 3-5+ years in media planning, brand or agency strategy, insights, client success, and/or account management. Media planning experience strongly preferred

  • Comfort with quantitative analysis and a data-driven approach to decision-making

  • Strategic thinking that goes beyond the obvious: you reframe the brief, question the assumption, and find the angle others miss

  • Advanced AI fluency. You can build skills, prompts, and workflows that change how work gets done

  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across all functions and levels

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including client-facing presentation experience

  • Strong proficiency with MS Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint

  • Familiarity with Looker or other data visualization tools

Compensation & Benefits

For candidates in California, Colorado, New York City, Illinois, Minnesota, New Jersey, Vermont, Washington, and Massachusetts, the Targeted Base Salary Range for this role is $90,000 to $100,000.

Actual salaries will vary depending on factors including, but not limited to, work experience, specialized skills and training, performance in the role, business needs, and job requirements. Base salary is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Base salary is just one component of InMarket's total rewards package, which may also include bonuses, equity, and benefits. Ask your recruiter for more information!

Additional perks and benefits:

  • Competitive salary and stock options

  • Flexible vacation / Unlimited PTO (within reason)

  • Medical, dental, and Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

  • Company Matched 401(k)

  • Paid Paternity & Maternity Leave

  • Agile Development Program for continued learning and professional development

Equal Opportunity Employer

At InMarket, diversity is not just a value; it's the very essence of who we are. It's about recognizing and celebrating the unique perspectives each of us brings, from our colleagues to the communities we serve. We are committed to embracing the full spectrum of backgrounds, beliefs, abilities, and life experiences, knowing that this diversity strengthens us. At InMarket, our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion means valuing each individual's unique contributions. Together, we thrive.

Business Development is seeking to add a highly motivated and experienced Associate Director, M&A and Strategic Development to support the continued growth of the Hanwha Renewables (“HWR”) and Hanwha Energy USA (HEUH) platforms.

This individual will play a leadership role in the evaluation, structuring, negotiation, and execution of mergers & acquisitions, project divestitures, strategic investments, joint ventures, and broader corporate development initiatives. This position will report to the Chief Business Development Officer (CBDO) or one of the CBDO’s senior team leaders. The employee may be required to perform other job-related duties as requested by management. All duties will be assigned in accordance with applicable laws and company policies. Working hours are Monday through Friday, from 8:00am to 5:00pm or 9:00am to 6:00pm local time. This position is expected to travel up to 50% of the time.

M&A and Transaction Execution

Strategic Corporate Development

Who We Are

Mile6 creates digital products and marketing experiences that drive breakout growth for clients on the cusp of big things. We are growth-centered, people-focused drivers of change.

You’ll join a team of strategists, marketers, designers, developers, and product professionals who bring different disciplines together to solve meaningful business problems. We trust and empower our teammates to do big and great things in and outside the day-to-day business of Mile6.

Sharing and learning are the responsibility of every member of the team. All teammates work with their manager to establish monthly, quarterly, and annual professional development goals.

As Mile6’s Growth Marketing Manager, you’ll lead performance-focused marketing programs that turn attention into qualified leads, retained audiences, and measurable growth.

Paid search will be your strongest discipline. You’ll own campaign strategy, execution, optimization, and reporting across platforms such as Google Ads and Social Media Advertising. You’ll also bring strong SEO and content marketing capabilities, helping Mile6 and our clients build sustainable organic visibility alongside paid acquisition.

This is a hands-on role for a curious generalist who enjoys connecting campaigns, search intent, content, landing pages, analytics, and user behavior.   • Use quantitative and qualitative data to understand visitor behavior and identify friction throughout the lead journey.

  • Strong understanding of keyword strategy, campaign architecture, bidding, budgets, audiences, ad testing, attribution, and conversion tracking.
  • Strong working knowledge of SEO, including content strategy, on-page optimization, keyword research, search intent, internal linking, and foundational technical SEO.
  • Experience developing and optimizing content that supports both search visibility and business goals.
  • Excellent copywriting and editing skills, with particular strength in concise, persuasive headlines, advertisements, landing pages, and calls to action.
  • Experience with landing-page optimization, conversion-rate optimization, or structured marketing experimentation.
  • Ability to turn data and user behavior into clear hypotheses, recommendations, and priorities.
  • Familiarity with analytics, tag management, search reporting, heat-mapping, session-recording, or A/B testing platforms.
  • Ability to explain marketing performance clearly to clients and teammates with different levels of technical knowledge.

  • Curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to question assumptions and continually improve how work gets done.

Bonus Points

  • Experience marketing B2B services, SaaS products, digital products, or complex buying journeys.

Our Benefits

Our Commitment

If you’re a performance marketer who knows paid search deeply, understands how SEO and content create lasting growth, and gets excited about testing the words and experiences that turn visitors into leads, we’d love to meet you.

As a Lead Product Designer, you'll own a pillar of the CompanyCam experience: its impact, quality, and craft end to end, and a leading voice in shaping its roadmap, not just executing against a brief. At CompanyCam, your work makes a real impact. Whether you're writing code, supporting customers, or designing experiences, your contributions directly shape the product we deliver and the people we serve. We're building something that helps real people solve real problems—and we believe that kind of work is best done by a team that reflects the world around us. In this role, you’ll drive impact by:

  • Defining and protecting the core product experience, ensuring workflows, information architecture, and surfaces remain cohesive as the product grows.
  • Raising the quality, judgment, and consistency of the broader design team through mentorship, leadership, and visible excellence in your own work.
  • Influencing product strategy and organizational decision-making by connecting design execution to broader business, customer, and operational outcomes.
  • Driving solutions that improve long-term simplicity, scalability, product coherence, and genuinely improves the lives of our customers.
  • Helping CompanyCam scale faster without sacrificing usability, foundational quality, or the integrity of the customer experience.

  • Formal education in Human-Computer Interaction, Product Design, or a related field.
  • Experience mentoring, hiring, or formally leading other designers.
  • Demonstrated AI workflow fluency and excitement for integrating modern tools into design practice.

What Success Looks Like

You'll know you're succeeding if:

  5. Your peers trust your judgment. When you push for quality, people listen.

Benefits & Compensation

This is a salaried position at CompanyCam. Our starting salary range is $178,000–$200,000 per year and is based on experience. We also offer meaningful equity and other benefits.

You'll build and evolve experimentation frameworks, test new ideas, and partner closely with product, marketing, creative, and game teams to improve store performance across the portfolio — stepping in to run ASO execution while the Product Marketing team scales the function. From icons, screenshots, videos, and copy to keyword strategy and custom store experiences, you'll help shape the moments that connect players with our games.

We're looking for someone who enjoys turning signals into action, challenges assumptions through testing, and can be effective from day one — this role needs minimal ramp-up given the contract term.

What you'll achieve

  • As ASO Specialist, you will own ASO execution across the Fortis portfolio for the contract term, including keyword strategy and metadata optimization
  • Build and run custom store experiences using Custom Product Pages (CPPs) and Custom Store Listings (CSLs)
  • Run A/B tests on store assets — icons, screenshots, video, copy — and translate results into next steps
  • Improve conversion rate across multiple titles simultaneously through structured experimentation
  • Integrate AI-driven workflows into ASO execution for keyword optimization, competitive analysis, and experimentation

  • Contribute from week one — minimal ramp-up expected given the contract term

What you'll need to be successful

  • Hands-on experience managing ASO for mobile apps or games, including CPPs and CSLs — non-negotiable

  • Analytical and creative hybrid — reads performance data and translates it into creative direction
  • Background in mobile gaming or large-scale app ecosystems; CET (timezone) overlap strongly preferred for day-to-day collaboration

Why join us

There are many reasons to join us, but here are a few:

  • We're not just about making Games Where You Belong. We're also about building communities where our people belong. That's why Fortis is a thriving environment that celebrates diversity, embraces inclusivity, and fosters growth.

jobs.title: Customer Success - Singapore Clients - Remote
jobs.excerpt: Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.
jobs.description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate 3 business segments:

Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 15,000 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 500 staff with an intact startup mindset.

We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia.

Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

Requirements

We are looking for Customer Success - Renewals person who is excited about the below Mission and Outcome.

Mission: The main mission is to help Sleek achieve its revenue target by renewing all services in our existing clientele.

We are looking for a customer focused, sales and data driven customer success person to join the team and contribute to Sleek’s growth!

Outcomes:

  1. Achieve renewal rate targets on a monthly basis, along with CSAT targets
  2. Conduct detailed investigations into the customer’s end-to-end interactions with Sleek, working cross-functionally with relevant departments to drive resolution. Ensure a high level of customer satisfaction that supports trust, retention, and a seamless renewal.
  3. Achieve cash collection targets on a monthly basis through renewal, upsell and upgrades.
  4. Have a good understanding of own pipeline, track it in a data driven manner, prioritise ticket resolution to drive monthly targets
  5. Collaborate with cross functional teams (accounting, corpsec, product, data) to improve renewal processes, share best practices with team and also be proactive in nature

To do this, you will have a minimum of 8 years experience as Sales, Account Management or Customer Success, in role carrying sales target and customer facing abilities and you will be located in the Singapore or in the Philippines.

Must Haves:

  • Experience working with SMEs, startups, fast paced setups in Singapore market
  • Exposure to different culture because Sleek clients are from all over the world
  • Ability to resolve issues by collaborating internally and externally
  • Familiar with Tableau, Zendesk, Husbpot
  • Experience handling complex customers and trouble shooting/escalations
  • Proactive to take up new projects to completion

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

Sales Driven & Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the sales team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

Humility: There is so much we don’t know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.

Structured Thinking & Target Focused: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you’re more analytical or creative in nature, keeping in view our business goals and being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.

Data driven: We are a data rich business with ~15,000 small customers. Each decision we make can impact many more people than we realise - so it’s critical that we use sound data to support our strategies and review the success of our initiatives.

Can have tough conversations in a positive way: It’s not a matter of if, but when difficult interpersonal situations arise. Disagreement, conflict and disappointment are a given in a fast moving business where people care about their work. People that proactively have tough conversations with kindness, build empathy, trust and great working relationships. Strong language proficiency in English is required

Excellent listener and clear communicator: We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn’t their first language. For you to excel, you’ll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business.

Customer-centric: You always act with the best interest of the customer in mind and empathize with their situation to find the best solution for them and for Sleek.

Problem Solving: You’ll need to be able to think on your feet as this role requires you to identify, diagnose, and resolve production issues quickly, reducing downtime. You will leverage your strong infrastructure and development skills in post-incident reviews to find the underlying cause of failures and prevent future incidents.

Collaboration-Driven: You thrive in a cross-functional team environment, working closely with developers, product managers, and operations teams to ensure alignment on requirements and testing goals. You communicate effectively, advocate for quality throughout the development process, and proactively address potential issues before they arise, fostering a culture of shared responsibility for delivering exceptional software.

Autonomous/ Entrepreneurial: Things move fast at Sleek and we are not a hierarchical organisation. We want the candidate to proactively seek out and own solutions without waiting for their manager to ask them. We want the candidate to have the confidence to execute solutions on their own and the experience to know when to ask questions.

The interview process

The successful candidate will participate in the below interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

Whether the interviews are held over video call or in person will depend on your location and the role.

Self Video / TA Interview

A ~30 minute chat with the Talent Acquisition . They’ll discuss your last 1-2 roles to understand

your experience in more detail.

Case study

A ~60 minute chat with the Hiring Manager, where they will give you some real-life

challenges that this role faces, and will ask for your approach to solving them.

Soft-skills assessment

A ~60 minute chat with a member of the HR or leadership team, where they will dive into

some of your recent work situations to understand how you think and work.

Offer + reference interviews

We’ll make a non-binding offer verbally or over email, followed by a couple of short phone or

video calls with references that you provide to us.

+++++

Requirement for background screening

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role.

This may include using external vendors to verify the below:

  • Your education
  • Any criminal history
  • Any political exposure
  • Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at sleek.com.

Benefits

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility: You’ll be able to work from home. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don’t mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: You’ll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you’ll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There’s also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We’re also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we’ve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we’ve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

jobs.description:
Financial Modeling Specialist (FP&A, Investment Banking & Strategic Finance) – Remote | U.S. Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients — a YC-backed (W25) technology company — is hiring a Financial Modeling Specialist to build, review, and improve sophisticated financial and business models used within structured AI training workflows.

This is a highly analytical, execution-focused role for finance professionals with strong backgrounds in financial modeling, FP&A, investment banking, private equity, strategic finance, corporate finance, or financial consulting.

You’ll build complete financial and operating models, develop forecasting and KPI frameworks, review models for accuracy and structural integrity, and help establish scalable modeling standards.

This role is ideal for someone who can take broad financial requirements, structure them independently, and produce clean, accurate, scalable, and well-documented financial models.

What You’ll Own

Financial Modeling & Analysis

Build sophisticated, end-to-end financial models, including:

  • Three-statement financial models
  • Operating models
  • Forecasting models
  • KPI frameworks
  • Scenario and sensitivity analyses
  • Revenue and cost models
  • Cash flow models
  • Business performance models

You’ll:

  • Translate broad requirements into structured modeling approaches.
  • Develop clear assumptions and financial drivers.
  • Build scalable formulas and model architecture.
  • Ensure consistency between income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow assumptions.
  • Structure outputs so models are easy to understand, audit, and modify.
  • Apply strong accounting and financial analysis principles throughout the modeling process.

Forecasting & Financial Analysis

Develop and refine forecasts using operational and financial assumptions.

Responsibilities may include:

  • Revenue forecasting
  • Expense forecasting
  • Cash flow planning
  • KPI development
  • Scenario modeling
  • Variance analysis
  • Operating performance analysis

Ensure forecasts appropriately reflect underlying business drivers and accounting relationships.

Model Review & Quality Control

Review financial models created by other analysts and identify issues related to:

  • Model structure
  • Formula accuracy
  • Accounting logic
  • Forecasting assumptions
  • Cash flow alignment
  • Revenue recognition
  • Model consistency
  • Documentation

You’ll:

  • Audit formulas and calculations.
  • Identify structural or logical weaknesses.
  • Correct inconsistencies and modeling errors.
  • Challenge assumptions where appropriate.
  • Improve readability and scalability.
  • Ensure models can be reviewed efficiently by other finance professionals.

U.S. GAAP & Accounting Integration

Apply strong accounting knowledge when developing and reviewing models.

You should understand:

  • U.S. GAAP
  • Revenue recognition
  • Accrual vs. cash accounting
  • Working capital
  • Financial statement relationships
  • Cash flow mechanics
  • Forecasting and variance analysis

Ensure modeling outputs remain financially coherent and appropriately reflect accounting relationships.

Modeling Frameworks & Documentation

Help establish scalable financial modeling infrastructure.

You’ll:

  • Improve existing modeling templates.
  • Standardize model structures.
  • Develop repeatable frameworks.
  • Document assumptions and methodologies.
  • Maintain clear modeling conventions.
  • Improve financial modeling best practices.
  • Create documentation that allows other analysts to understand and reproduce modeling logic.

AI Training & Structured Finance Workflows

Your financial expertise will contribute to structured workflows used to support advanced AI systems.

You’ll apply finance judgment to:

  • Complex financial modeling tasks.
  • Structured analytical problems.
  • Model evaluation and quality control.
  • Financial reasoning workflows.
  • Standardized modeling frameworks.

The focus is on bringing high-quality human financial reasoning and modeling discipline into structured analytical workflows.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Participate in recurring working sessions with internal teams to align on:

  • Modeling methodologies
  • Financial assumptions
  • Quality standards
  • Documentation requirements
  • Model architecture
  • Analytical frameworks

Clearly explain the reasoning behind your models, assumptions, and recommendations.

Peer Review & Mentorship

When needed, provide structured feedback to junior analysts and peers.

Help improve:

  • Modeling accuracy
  • Formula consistency
  • Financial reasoning
  • Documentation quality
  • Overall analytical standards

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Have

  • 3–7+ years of hands-on financial modeling experience.
  • Proven experience building sophisticated financial models from scratch.
  • Advanced proficiency in:
    • Microsoft Excel
    • Google Sheets
  • Strong understanding of:
    • U.S. GAAP
    • Revenue recognition
    • Accrual vs. cash accounting
    • Cash flow mechanics
    • Forecasting
    • Variance analysis
    • Financial statement relationships
  • Experience building and auditing complex financial models.
  • Ability to translate broad requirements into structured financial models.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently with limited supervision.
  • Availability during U.S. client business hours.

Preferred Backgrounds

Strong candidates may come from:

  • Investment Banking
  • Private Equity
  • FP&A
  • Strategic Finance
  • Corporate Finance
  • Financial Consulting
  • Transaction Advisory
  • Accounting + Financial Modeling hybrid roles

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with AI-related projects or AI training workflows.
  • Exposure to structured datasets or analytical data workflows.
  • Experience reviewing or evaluating other analysts’ financial models.
  • Experience working across multiple industries or business models.
  • Experience developing financial modeling templates and standards.
  • Experience documenting complex financial methodologies.
  • Experience mentoring junior analysts.
  • Exposure to fast-growing technology or startup environments.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Think in models, drivers, assumptions, and financial relationships.
  • Can turn an ambiguous business problem into a structured analytical framework.
  • Understand how the three financial statements interact.
  • Catch formula errors and logical inconsistencies quickly.
  • Challenge assumptions instead of accepting them at face value.
  • Build models that another finance professional can easily audit.
  • Care deeply about accuracy, consistency, and documentation.
  • Can explain complex financial logic clearly.
  • Work effectively without needing detailed step-by-step instructions.
  • Enjoy highly analytical, focused work.
  • Maintain quality even when working through complex or repetitive modeling tasks.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include:

  • Building financial and operating models from broad requirements.
  • Developing assumptions and financial drivers.
  • Refining revenue, expense, and cash flow forecasts.
  • Building KPI and scenario-analysis frameworks.
  • Reviewing models created by other analysts.
  • Auditing formulas and identifying modeling inconsistencies.
  • Testing whether financial statements and assumptions align correctly.
  • Participating in working sessions around modeling standards.
  • Providing structured feedback to other analysts.
  • Updating modeling templates and documentation.
  • Improving the consistency and scalability of financial frameworks.

In short: you build, audit, and improve sophisticated financial models that bring high-quality financial reasoning into advanced AI training workflows.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Accuracy and integrity of financial models.
  • Quality of financial assumptions and modeling logic.
  • Reliability of model outputs.
  • Speed and consistency of model delivery.
  • Reduction in formula, structural, and accounting errors.
  • Quality and scalability of modeling frameworks.
  • Clarity of financial documentation.
  • Quality of peer model reviews.
  • Ability to deliver complex analytical work independently.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Work with a YC-backed technology company operating at the intersection of finance and AI.
  • Apply investment banking, FP&A, and strategic finance skills to emerging AI applications.
  • Work on sophisticated financial modeling problems rather than transactional accounting.
  • High ownership and analytical autonomy.
  • Exposure to advanced financial modeling frameworks.
  • Opportunity to help improve how AI systems work with financial and business models.
  • Collaborate with highly analytical and technical teams.
  • Fully remote opportunity with long-term growth potential.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video
  3. Zoom Interview with Pavago HR Team
  4. Short Financial Modeling Assignment
  5. 15-Minute Client Sync
  6. Extensive Financial Modeling Assessment
  7. Final Interview with Client Team
  8. Offer & Background Check

Apply Now

If you have a strong background in financial modeling, FP&A, investment banking, private equity, strategic finance, or corporate finance and can independently build clean, scalable, and accurate financial models, we’d love to hear from you.

This role is particularly well suited for high-agency finance professionals who enjoy complex analytical work, structured problem-solving, financial model building, and rigorous quality control.
